__abilitiesCards.name: Special Abilities
__abilitiesCards.desc:
Special Abilities:
Class Benefits:
• Weapon Experties: 3/2 Attacks.
• Suspicious mustache: Detect Evil at will, 60ft Range.
• Healthy Living: +2 to all saving throw rolls.
• Pfizericious: Immune to Disease
• Lay on Hands: Heal 2HP per level
• It hurts when I: Cure Disease, 1/week
• Blinded by the light: 10ft Aura of Protection, evil creatures -1 to attack
• This is my boom stick: Holy Weapon held aloft dispels magic, lvl = caster lvl
• Improved Parry: +1 + 1/2 Level to AC
• Bard Spells
• Theif Skills
• Influence Reaction, Inspire, Counter Song
• Legendary Lore 5% per level

Class Hinderances:
• Unselfish: No more than 10 major magic items.
• Empty Pockets: Can't keep cash beyond maintenance  except saving for major items (order membership, better armor, better horse, etc.)
• For the Faith: Tithe to the church, 10%
• We're all individuals here: Can only employ Lawful Good henchmen.

__abilitiesCards.name: Racial Abilities
__abilitiesCards.desc:
Racial Abilities: Twice as Bright Half as Long, Bonus Weapon Proficiency, Bonus Non-Weapon Proficiency, XP Reduction

Kit Benefits:
• Skilled: +1 to hit with any Lance or Sword
• Brave: Immune to fear. Negates fear in allies within 10’.
• Resolute: +4 to saves vs. mind controlling effects.
• Mounted: Starts play with a horse, charger quality.
• Beloved: +3 reaction adjustment from own culture. -3 criminals and evil.
• Essence of Purity: +1 hp per level. Re-roll any save that would result in death. Linger with death poem. While defending love, innocence, or beauty fight on for 1d4 rounds or till next damage.
• Code of Gallant: Gain inner confidence bonus. +2 bonus can be applied to attack, damage, AC, or saving throw. Decide any time.
• Romantic Appeal: Save vs. Paralyzation -2 to adjust encounter more friendly by 1. If mixed sex group, females+1/males-1.
• Poetic Charm: 1d10 turns to charm a woman with  -2 Paralyzation save.

Kit Hinderances:
• Wanderer: No-stronghold, no troops, just a squire at 5th level.
• Have-at-you: Must attack in melee if able unless there are special circ.s.
• Bigger they are: Must seek to attack seemingly most powerful opponent.
• Finer things: Must accept and purchase only the finest items.

__abilitiesCards.name: Code / Personality
__abilitiesCards.desc:
Code of Chivalry(ishness)
•        Cheerfully perform any noble service or request
•        Defend to the death any person or item in his charge
•        Show courage and enterprise always
•        Respect for all peers and equals, if you can find any
•        Honor all those above his station, unless unworthy
•        Expect respect and obedience from those below his station
•        Scorn those who are greedy, cruel, lowly and ignoble
•        Perform military services when asked by his liege
•        Show courtesy to all ladies, and appreciate them ...
•        War is the flowering of Chivalry and a noble enterprise
•        Battle is a test of manhood and combat is glory
•        Must achieve personal glory in battle
•        Slay all those who oppose my cause
•        Death before dishonor

Code of the Gallant
•        Defend lovers, the innocent, and the fairer sex, and lend aid
•        Never marry or vow to love only one person
•        Never retreat from combat until allies of the fairer sex have retreated
•        Never overstay your welcome
•        Spend half his money on the innocent and romance
•        Own only that which I can take with me.

Other:
• War wound: Limp, +1 for flankers on right rear. Int check to detect. Infertile.
• Art: Does nude sketches of people, entirely from imagination.
